Do NOT treat _v2 as validated/equivalent to the oracle. Also has the known double 'packet:packet:' node_key prefix bug (writer fixed 2026-08-24, existing rows not backfilled). Neither _v2 nor non-v2 atlas_graph_authority_scores is currently trustworthy as canonical; the only cross-validated PageRank result for this graph revision is the unpromoted Aug-12 oracle NDJSON output itself.
